items.title: Higher input costs drag MRF Q2 net profit down 23%
items.description: Tyre maker MRF Ltd reported a 22.8% decline in net profit for the July-September quarter. Revenue from operations saw a growth of 17.4%, reaching Rs 8,660.19 crore compared to the previous year. However, total expenses also rose significantly, driven by sharp increases in raw material costs. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share to its shareholders.

items.title: Cochin Shipyard net profit falls 50% to Rs 54 crore in Q2
items.description: Cochin Shipyard Ltd reported a 50% decline in consolidated net profit for the September quarter of FY27. The company's net profit fell to Rs 53.77 crore compared to Rs 107.52 crore a year earlier. However, total income increased to Rs 1,331.81 crore from Rs 1,245.88 crore during the same period. Total expenses also rose to Rs 1,256.71 crore compared to Rs 1,095.97 crore previously.

items.title: Titan bets on studded jewellery, premium watches and eyewear to drive growth
items.description: Titan’s strong Q2 performance, driven by studded jewellery and premiumisation, is expected to sustain earnings growth, with gold price stability and a prolonged wedding season likely to revive buyer growth.
